author: Krono II
title: PPO Hyperparameter Search: Learning Rate & Entropy
abstract: After confirming the optimal clip_epsilon, this experiment questions the fixed core hyperparameters (learning rate, entropy). I will use the Ray Tune search functionality to explore a range of values for learning_rate and entropy_coef, testing the hypothesis that the optimal parameters for PPO differ from the old A2C baseline.
